data.one_liner: An easy-to-use library for communicating with WebSockets that has multiple implementations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple, well-defined WebSocket interface with consistent behavior across different implementations. It includes conformance-tested implementations for browsers, Cupertino, IO, and OkHttp.
use_when: You need a consistent WebSocket interface across multiple platforms and implementations.
You want an alternative to complex WebSocket packages.
avoid_when: You require advanced features exclusive to package:web_socket_channel not present here.
strengths: Passes the same set of conformance tests.
weaknesses: Some implementations like OkHttpWebSocket are currently experimental.
